# Yempik Mail Gateway

> Yempik Mail Gateway is an open-source, self-hosted MCP server that gives AI agents safe access to Gmail, Microsoft 365 and Zoho Mail. It adds draft-first delivery, per-identity daily send limits, idempotent sends, reconciliation of uncertain sends, audit logging and a global kill switch. It sends from the user's own mailboxes through their official APIs. It is not a bulk email service, an ESP or a cold-email spam tool. Created by Yempik and maintained by Raffaele Zarrelli and Simone Bova. MIT license.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/README.md): overview, capabilities and quick start.
- [MCP tools reference](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/docs/MCP_TOOLS.md): all 16 tools with inputs, outputs, errors and the error code table.
- [AI citation notes](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/AI-CITATION.md): the canonical description and key facts.

## Documentation

- [Architecture](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): packages, request flow, data model and the draft state machine.
- [Security model](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, the draft-first invariant, token encryption, log redaction and the admin surface.
- [Operations](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): deploy on Vercel and Neon, environment variables, migrations, signatures, kill switch, send limits, reconciliation, secret rotation and rollback.
- [Google OAuth setup](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/docs/GOOGLE_OAUTH_SETUP.md): connect Gmail mailboxes.
- [Microsoft Entra setup](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/docs/MICROSOFT_ENTRA_SETUP.md): connect Microsoft 365 mailboxes, with tenant pinning.
- [Zoho Mail setup](https://github.com/yempik-ai/mail-gateway/blob/main/docs/ZOHO_MAIL_SETUP.md): connect Zoho Mail mailboxes.

## Decisions
